description: Free here, shows the price first: opens a paid retrain of a FINISHED custom voice with more sentences. Returns Ania’s recording page (only NEW sentences, never a repeated one; goal +150 to +300) for the person whose voice it is. Then voice_status and train_voice on the returned order_id (paid, confirmed like any spend; refunded if training fails). The current version is kept; the person picks which to use.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

order_id.description: Order id of the FINISHED voice to improve (voice_status lists them).

name: improve_voice
title: Improve a finished custom voice
